title: CompositeTrustQuery
description: Axis 4 composite trust-query envelope. Assembles N independently-signed emitter rows under one (payment_hash, action_ref) anchor. composite_hash is derived per specs/composite-trust-query.md.

emitter_rows.description: Set of emitter rows. Transmission order is NOT significant; the composite preimage sorts by source_id.

composite_hash.description: SHA-256(JCS([row_preimages sorted by source_id])); per-row sig fields excluded from the preimage.

action_ref.description: 32-byte SHA-256 work-receipt digest; raw lowercase hex, no prefix (per draft-vauban-x402-stark-receipts-00).

source_id.description: Emitter surface identifier, form <org>.<surface>. Canonical sort key for the composite preimage.

framework.description: Declared regulatory or technical frameworks; MAY be empty.

anchor.description: MUST equal the envelope anchor field-for-field.

evidence_ref.description: Resolvable pointer to the underlying attestation or fixture.

sig.description: Per-row signature. EXCLUDED from the composite preimage; verification metadata, not content.
